source: 765 Howl
target: 765 Ululatus

source: Lumian thought for a moment and then specifically reminded, “Don’t forget the Four of Swords.”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde specialiter admonuit: “Ne obliviscaris Quattuor Gladii!”

source: To be honest, he almost overlooked Anthony’s presence, but because he was constantly thinking about what his teammates were doing and how to coordinate with them, he didn’t forget entirely.
target: Ad veritatem, paene praeterspiciebat praesentiam Antonii, sed quoniam constanter de eo cogitabat quid sodales sequerentur et quomodo cum illis se coordineret, non plane obliviscebatur.

source: When he invited the two Demonesses to Chaban Street at St. Millom Restaurant, Lumian didn’t think of Anthony right away.
target: Cum duas Demonassas ad viam Chaban, apud Popinam Sancti Millom invitavit, Lumian non statim de Antonio cogitavit.

source: It was only when he reached the street that he remembered their teammate.
target: Tandem, cum viam attigit, sodalem eorum recordatus est.

source: But he couldn’t find the Hypnotist, who had used Psychological Invisibility.
target: Sed Hypnotistam, qui occultationem psychologicam adhibuerat, invenire non potuit.

source: He could only trust that Anthony, with his rich experience, would realize that once the rest of the team had gathered together, it was clear the next actions weren’t suited to splitting up, and he would follow.
target: Tantummodo confidebat quod Antonius, opulenta experientia praeditus, intellexerit postquam reliqui sodales congregati essent, manifestum fore ut sequentia consilia non ad dissociationem convenirent, atque ille sequi debetur.

source: Anthony’s habits as an information broker combined well with Psychological Invisibility.
target: Consuetudines Antonii, ut mercator notitiarum agirent, optime cum occultatione psychologica conveniebant.

source: After a two-second pause following Lumian’s reminder, the Knight of Swords said, “We won’t forget.”
target: Post duas secundas moram post admonitionem Lumiani, Eques Gladii dixit: “Non obliviscemur.”

source: It seems like you already did… but the temperance faction’s demigod shouldn’t be affected much by Anthony’s Psychological Invisibility, so when sending Franca and Jenna away, they shouldn’t really forget about Anthony…
target: Videtur quasi iam fecistis… sed semideus factionis temperantiae non debet nimis affici ab occultatione psychologica Antonii, itaque, cum Francam et Jennam dimitterent, vere Antonium non obliviscantur.

source: If that’s the case, one major cause of death for a Hypnotist would definitely be that Psychological Invisibility works too well, causing teammates to forget or overlook them…
target: Si ita sit, una ex maximis mortis causis Hypnotistae certe esset quod occultatio psychologica nimis optime operetur, efficiente ut sodales eos obliviscantur aut praetermitterent.

source: As Lumian mused to himself, the special Paramita before him suddenly changed.
target: Dum Lumian meditaret, specialis Paramita ante eum subito mutata est.

source: A deafening crash sounded from Lake Dalsh as gray-white water surged upward like a tsunami, reaching into the air.
target: Ex Lago Dalsh sonuit fragor ingens, dum aquae cinereo-albae quasi tsunami in aethera surrexerunt.

source: The wilderness, already intertwined with the city of Raklev, began to dominate.
target: Vastitas agrestis, iam cum urbe Raklev intertexta, dominari incipiebat.

source: In an instant, it crossed squares and streets, swallowing Lumian, who had not yet reached Chaban Street, while avoiding Franca and the others.
target: In uno momento, per fora et vias transiit, Lumian, qui viam Chaban nondum attigerat, devorans, dum Francam et ceteros vitabat.

source: Oxyto, blessed by the Great Mother, seemed to realize she had been exposed.
target: Oxyto, Magna Matre benedicta, videbatur intellexisse se patefactam esse.

source: Her choice was to use the nature of Paramita to temporarily separate the blasphemer of the Child of God from the temperance faction’s demigods, then exploit the brief time difference to achieve her desired goal regarding Lumian.
target: Optio eius fuit ut natura Paramitae adhiberetur ad paulisper separandum blasphemerum Filii Dei a semideis factionis temperantiae, deinde brevissimo intervallo tempore ad propositum suum de Lumiano assequendum.

source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian, wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask and transformed into an undead, felt his body grow “heavier,” as if cold masses had taken residence inside him.
target: Fere simul, Lumian, larvam auream familiae Eggers gerens et in mortuos conversus, sensit corpus suum gravius fieri, quasi massae frigidae in eo sedes dederint.

source: In the next second, he saw the indistinct human figures on Chaban Street vanish, along with Franca, Jenna, Ludwig, Lugano, and possibly Anthony behind him.
target: In secundo proximo, vidit figuras humanas in via Chaban indistinctas evanescere, una cum Franca, Jenna, Ludwig, Lugano, et fortasse Antonio post se.

source: It was as if they were in two separate worlds.
target: Ut si in duobus mundis distinctis essent.

source: The human skulls in various states became increasingly distinct, their eye sockets burning with pale or dark red flames as they all turned to face Lumian.
target: Crania humana variis modis magis distincta apparebant, orbitae eorum ignibus pallidisque aut obscurorum rubrorum ardentes, dum omnes ad Lumian converterentur.

source: At the end of Chaban Street, at the city’s edge where it blended more deeply with the wilderness, swaying figures crawled out from unknown places and began walking toward Lumian.
target: In fine viae Chaban, in oram urbis ubi cum vastitate agrestis mixtum erat, figurae vacillantes ex locis ignotis emergere coepere et in Lumian ambulare incipiebant.

source: There were rotting long-haired oxen with only a few pieces of pus-oozing flesh left, giant birds with exposed bones flying low, pythons dragging half-melted threads of flesh between their decaying tissues, and monstrous hills made of multiple headless skeletons.
target: Erant boves longipilos putridi, quorum tantum paucae particulae carnis suppurantis relictae erant, aves ingentes cum ossibus patentibus parvo volantes, pythones quae dimidia filum carnis liquefactae inter putrescentes telas trahentes, et colles monstruosos ex multis scheletis sine capitibus constitutos. skulls from all corners of the city were also swiftly converging on Chaban Street, floating in the air and covering the sky, blocking out the pale, dim, and heatless “sunlight.”

source: Lumian appeared stunned, as if he had encountered something terrifying, or was like an undead creature facing a higher-ranked and more terrifying kindred spirit.
target: Lumian stupefactus apparuit, quasi aliquid terribile convenisset, aut ut creatura mortua adversus spiritum cognatum, altiori et terribili, obviam egeret.

source: For a brief moment, he stood frozen, unable to move.
target: Per brevem momentum stetit immobilis, neque se movere poterat.

source: Just then, a wretched howl, filled with pain, echoed from Lake Dalsh.
target: Tum, miserrimus ululatus, dolore repletus, ex Lago Dalsh resonavit.

source: The terrifying and piercing sound was like a high-speed spinning drill that bored directly into Lumian’s soul.
target: Sonus terribilis et acutus erat, velut terebra celeriter gyrans, quae in animam Lumiani directe pervenit.

source: His vision went dark, and he lost consciousness.
target: Visus eius obscuratus est, et conscientiam amisit.

source: When Lumian regained his thoughts and awareness of his body, he found himself midway along Chaban Street, accompanied by the Knight of Swords Maric, who had appeared at some point, dressed in a black vest and white shirt.
target: Cum Lumian cogitationes et sensum corporis sui recipere coepisset, invenit se in media viae Chaban, comitatus a Equestre Gladii Maric, qui aliquando apparuerat, veste nigra et camisia alba indutus.

source: All around him, crystalline cold had frozen human skulls of varying states in mid-air, on the ground, and on the surfaces of gray-white stone buildings.
target: Omnibis circa eum, glacies crystallina, craneos humanos variis modis in aere, in terra, et super superficies aedificiorum lapideorum cinereo-alborum congelaverat.

source: The surreal frozen scene stretched all the way to the wilderness on the outskirts of the city.
target: Scaena surrealistica congelata usque ad solitudinem in extremis urbis extendebatur.

source: In the staggering army of undead creatures, the rotting monsters shed flesh onto the ground, leaving only bones-yellowed, brown, or bleached white.
target: In ingenti exercitu creaturarum mortuorum, monstra putrida carnem in terram effuderunt, relinquentes tantum ossa quae flavae, fuscae aut candidae erant.

source: The skeletal remains sank into the soil, and droplets of crimson blood, not their own, oozed from the surface.
target: Reliquiae scheletrales in terram ceciderunt, et guttas sanguinis coccinei, non propriorum, ex superficie exsudaverunt.

source: Meanwhile, the wraiths and evil spirits swelled like balloons and burst silently, turning into strange dust.
target: Interim, umbrae et spiritus mali quasi globi inflati erant, et silentio eruperunt, in pulverem insolitum vertentes.

source: Although Lumian didn’t fully understand what was happening, two thoughts sprang to mind: Have they all been cursed?
target: Quamquam Lumian non plene intellexit quid ageretur, duo cogitationes in mentem eius immediate venerunt: num omnes maledicti sint?

source: Even the fleshless bones were cursed to bleed?
target: Etiam ossa sine carne maledicta sunt ut sanguinem effundantur?

source: With that thought, Lumian couldn’t help but raise his right hand and wipe his nose.
target: Hac cogitatione, Lumian non potuit prohibere ut dextram manum tolleret et nasum suum abstergeret.

source: He immediately noticed some blackened bloodstains on the back of his hand.
target: Statim animadvertit nonnullas maculas sanguinis nigras in dorso manūs eius.

source: This came from within his body, blood that had long since stopped flowing.
target: Hoc ex interno corpore eius oriebatur, sanguis qui iam diutius fluere desierat.

source: In the banshee’s wail just now, not only was his soul wounded, but his undead body seemed to have suffered physical damage too.
target: In recenti lamentatione Bansheei, non solum anima eius vulnerata est, sed et corpus eius mortuum, ut videbatur, damna physica passa est.

source: Some capillaries had ruptured, causing the blackened blood to seep out.
target: Quaedam capillaria rupta erant, quae sanguinem nigrum effundere fecerunt.

source: Terrifying… Lumian had roughly figured out what had just happened.
target: Terribile… Lumian paene intellexit quid modo accideret.

source: Oxyto screamed from a distance, using the Banshee’s Howl enhanced by Paramita, and!
target: Oxyto ex longinquo clamavit, utens ululatu Bansheei per Paramita amplificato, et!

source: instantly lost consciousness.
target: Statim conscientiam amisit.

source: Did the temperance faction’s demigods attach themselves to me as wraiths before Paramita expanded, pulling me into Paramita right away?
target: Num semidei factionis temperantiae, antequam Paramita expandebatur, se ut umbrae ad me applicaverunt, me statim in Paramitam trahentes?

source: Then, they took over my body and used their abilities to deal with the swarming army of human skulls and undead?
target: Tum corpus meum occupaverunt et facultates suas ad pugnandum contra exercitum humanorum craniorum et mortuorum usi sunt?

source: The Knight of Swords also attached himself to me, which is why he’s now in Paramita?
target: Et Eques Gladii se ad me applicavit, qua de causa nunc in Paramita versatur?

source: After grasping the recent encounter, Lumian had a clearer and more accurate understanding of the terror of demigods: Oxyto isn’t even a full Angel but just a Banshee’s Howl knocked me unconscious, robbing me of my ability to fight.
target: Postquam recentem eventum comprehenderat, Lumian claram et accuratam notionem terroris semideorum consecutus est: Oxyto quidem non est angelus integer, sed solum ululatus Bansheei, qui me in inopiam redegit, vim pugnandi mihi subtrahens.

source: It took me over ten seconds to wake up… Without the presence of temperance faction demigods, those ten seconds would have been more than enough for Oxyto to kill me ten times over…
target: Mihi plus quam decem secundis opus fuit ut evigilarer… Sine praesentia semideorum factionis temperantiae, illa decem secunda satis haberent ut Oxyto me decies occideret…

source: This isn’t something a drawn demigod can compare to.
target: Hoc non est res ad quam semideus evocatus comparari possit.

source: Facing a real demigod, if I don’t seize the initiative, I won’t even have the chance to draw the Sword of Courage or use Desire Incarnation!
target: Adversus verum semideum, nisi initium capiam, ne occasionem quidem habebo ut Gladium Fortitudinis traheam aut Incarnationem Desiderii adhibeam!

source: There’s no time for the animated shadow to take the damage for me unless I anticipate it in advance…
target: Nullum tempus est ut umbra animata pro me damnum subeam, nisi id ante praevideam.

source: With these thoughts swirling, Lumian regained control of his body.
target: His cogitationibus circulantibus, Lumian iterum dominari corpore suo coepit.

source: Then, he heard the Knight of Swords, Maric, mutter softly, “Oxyto has retreated. She should be near Lake Dalsh.”
target: Tum audivit Eques Gladii, Maric, leniter sussurrare: “Oxyto recessit. Prope Lacum Dalsh esse debet.”

source: “We still don’t know what kind of help she’s seeking.”
target: “Nondum scimus quid genere auxilii quaerat.”

source: “Lake Dalsh?” Lumian asked in mild surprise.
target: “Lacus Dalsh?” interrogavit Lumian, leniter admiratus.

source: That serene, beautiful, sacred lake?
target: Iste lacus serenus, pulcher, sacer?

source: On second thought, it makes sense. All mining operations in the Raklev region have avoided Lake Dalsh, leaving it entirely unpolluted…
target: Secunda cogitatione, rationem habet. Omnes operationes fodinarias in regione Raklev Lacum Dalsh vitaverunt, eum prorsus incontaminatum relinquentes…

source: The Knight of Swords surveyed the surroundings but didn’t immediately dash off into the wilderness toward Lake Dalsh.
target: Eques Gladii ambitum inspexit, sed non statim in solitudinem versus Lacum Dalsh festinavit.

source: He nodded slightly and said, “Lake Dalsh itself is special, connected to the fallen Death. The establishment of this small spirit realm in the Raklev region was made possible due to Lake Dalsh.”
target: Levis annuens ait: “Lacus Dalsh ipse specialis est, Morti lapsae conexus; constitutio huius parvi regni spirituum in regione Raklev facta est propter Lacum Dalsh.”

source: “That former Balam Empire official even used an Undying’s skull from the Church of Death and, using his Gatekeeper powers, opened a door to the Underworld and fixed it onto the Undying’s skull. This prevented it from completely closing too quickly, allowing a bit of the Underworld’s aura to leak out.”
target: Ille pristinus officialis Imperii Balam etiam calvarium Immortui ex Ecclesia Mortis usus est, et, utens viribus Custodis aditus, ianuam ad Orcum aperuit atque eam in calvarium Immortui fixavit. Hoc impedivit ne claudendi processus nimis celeriter completus esset, relinquens parvam partem aurae Orci effluere.

source: “The skull of an Undying? Undying can die too?” Lumian instinctively asked.
target: «Calvarium Immortui? Immortui etiam mori possunt?» rogavit Lumian instinctive.

source: The Knight of Swords started walking towards the edge of the frozen world.
target: Eques Gladii iter ad oram mundi congelati inchoavit ambulare.

source: He glanced at Lumian and said, “An Undying is only Sequence 4 in the Death pathway. They can still die if killed.”
target: Intuentem Lumian, dixit: “Immortui sunt tantum in Sequentia IV in via Mortis; adhuc mori possunt, si interfecti fuerint.”

source: I see… Lumian nodded almost imperceptibly.
target: Intellego… Lumian paene imperceptibiliter annuit.

source: The Knight of Swords continued, “The aura leaking from the Underworld, the unique traits of the Undying’s skull, and the special nature of Lake Dalsh all worked together to sustain this spirit realm, drawing the souls of dead creatures in the region and letting them gradually wither away.”
target: Eques Gladii continuavit: “Aura e Orco effluente, proprietates singulares calvari Immortui, et natura specialis Lacus Dalsh omnia simul coniuncta sunt ut hoc regnum spirituum sustentaret, animas creaturarum mortuorum in regione attrahendo et eas paulatim exaridire sinendo.”

source: After listening, Lumian froze for a moment.
target: Postquam audivit, Lumian per breve momentum immobilis stetit.

source: “You seem to know a lot about the local spirit realm…”
target: “Videtur te multa de regno spirituum locali scire…”

source: The Knight of Swords replied, “The Rose School of Thought ruled here for over a thousand years. Apart from the uniqueness of Lake Dalsh, everything else was long understood.”
target: Eques Gladii respondit: “Schola Rosacea cogitationis hic per ultra mille annos dominavit. Praeter singularitatem Lacus Dalsh, omnia alia diu nota erant.”

source: “Then why didn’t you say so earlier?” Lumian blurted out.
target: “Cur, igitur, non ante dixisti?” exclamavit Lumian.

source: If you’d told me sooner, I might have guessed Oxyto’s intentions earlier!
target: Si prius mihi dixeris, fortasse antea conicere potuissem quid Oxyto intendisset!

source: “We didn’t initially connect Oxyto to the spirit realm, so that intelligence wasn’t included in the information,” explained the Knight of Swords.
target: “Initio Oxyto non associabatur regno spirituum, ideo illa cognitio in notitia non inclusa erat,” explicavit Eques Gladii.

source: “After that, I answered whenever you asked, but didn’t elaborate. Speaking is also a desire that requires temperance.”
target: “Postea, quoties rogavisti, respondi sed non explicavi. Loqui quoque est desiderium quod temperantiam requirit.”

source: “…” Lumian suddenly understood how Franca felt every time she heard him say, “I’ll have to start with the events at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, where Madame Hela and 1…”
target: “…” Lumian subito intellexit quomodo Franca se haberet, quoties eum audiret dicentem, “Incipient a rebus ad Fons Samaritarum Feminarum, ubi Domina Hela et 1…”

source: While talking, he and Maric reached the edge of the city, where the frozen world met the desolate wilderness.
target: Dum loquebatur, ille et Maric ad limen urbis pervenerunt, ubi mundus congelatus cum vastitate desolata congressus est.

source: Lumian instinctively glanced at the thick layer of ice encasing the gray-white buildings.
target: Lumian instinctu aspexit spissum stratum glaciei quod aedificia cinereo-alba circumdabat.

source: Using the reflective surface, he was astonished to see a blurry figure in each of his eyes.
target: Reflectivam superficiem utens, stupuit videns figuram nebulosam in unoquoque oculo suo.

source: One wore a small black bonnet and a court dress of the same color; the other had no head and was dressed in a dark, intricately patterned, sinister gown.
target: Unus portabat parvulum bonnet nigrum et vestem curiæ eodem colore; alter caput non habebat et veste obscura, subtiliter designata, sinistra induta erat.

source: Lumian then noticed translucent-ringed insects crawling in and out of his mouth, yet he felt nothing.
target: Tum Lumian animadvertit insecta, anulis translucidis ornata, quae in ore eius serpentes intrabant et exeuntia erant; attamen nihil sensit.

source: At the entrance to Chaban Street, Franca, Jenna, and the others felt a sudden chill engulf them and saw Lumian vanish before their eyes.
target: Ad initium viae Chaban, Franca, Jenna et ceteri subito frigore invasos sensit et Lumian coram oculis eorum evanescere viderunt.

source: Before they could communicate or react, a voice, slightly magnetic and ethereal like a dream, echoed in their ears: “I’ll send you back to Trier first.”
target: Priusquam communicare vel agere possent, vox, paulum magnetica et aetheria ut somnium, in auribus eorum resonavit: “Primum vos ad Trier remittam.”

source: Franca, Jenna, and Lugano instinctively turned their bodies and discovered that a young-looking man had appeared next to them at some point.
target: Franca, Jenna et Lugano instinctive corpora sua converterunt et compererunt virum iuvenem ad eos apparuisse aliquando.

source: He wore a white shirt, draped in a thin black trench coat. With black hair and green eyes, he had a night-like, handsome quality, and wore a pair of red gloves on both hands.
target: Indutus erat camisia alba, pallio nigro tenue involutus; capillis nigris et oculis viridibus ornatus, indole nocturna et formosa, atque par chirothecarum rubrarum in utrisque manibus gerebat.
